level.title: Finnish B2 Upper Intermediate: Adults 30-50, debate, news, professional
level.description: Complete Finnish B2 course for Upper Intermediate. Adults 30-50, debate, news, professional. Includes 8 lessons, 150-180 study hours, visual learning with adult characters, country context from FI, dotted tracing, and cultural themes.
goals: Master B2 level Finnish for upper intermediate
Learn 96 new words about daily life in Finnish-speaking countries
Practice with visual aids: adult characters, country flags, cultural motifs
Complete 15 test questions and dotted tracing worksheets
